facts: This letter informs you that the claim for mental health consultation is not covered under your policy.
The Insured is not admitted as a day care or In-patient.

cited_clauses.quote: OPD Treatment is one in which the Insured Person visits a clinic/Hospital or associated facility like a consultation room for diagnosis and treatment based on the advice of a Medical Practitioner.

Pre-existing Disease means any condition, ailment, injury or disease i. That is/are diagnosed by a physician within 48 months prior to the effective date of the policy issued by the insurer or its reinstatement or ii. For which medical advice or treatment was recommended by, or received from, a physician within 48 months prior to the effective date of the policy issued by insurer or its reinstatement.

reasoning: The policy does not cover OPD Treatment for mental health consultations, which is the ground for rejection. The clause defines OPD Treatment as visits for diagnosis and treatment, not mental health consultations.
relief_sought: We request the insurer to reconsider the claim and cover the mental health consultation as it falls under the scope of OPD Treatment.
document_checklist: Copy of the claim rejection letter
Medical bills, prescriptions and investigation reports
Earlier correspondence with the insurer, including any grievance acknowledgement
deadline_note: A complaint to the Insurance Ombudsman needs a written representation to the insurer first; it must then be made within one year of the insurer's rejection, or of one month after the representation was sent (Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017, Rule 14(3), checked against the published text as amended till 09.11.2023; later amendments not checked). Confirm with the Ombudsman office before relying on a date, and compute dates with the deadline tool.
